dct_creator_sm: Pow, Virginia (University of Alberta Libraries, University of Alberta).
dct_description_sm: This is a GIS (.shp) file index to all of the printed 1:50,000 NTS sheets , both current and historical, that are held by the William C. Wonders Map Collection. The file is projected to NAD_1983_10TM_AEP_Forest. There are two copies of each NTS sheet, one in the public area of the map collection on the 4th floor of Cameron Library, while the other set is stored off campus at BARD.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: National Topographic System (NTS) 1:50000 Index for Alberta
